name: 调色板色觉可辨识度检查器

map.把一组配色贴进来，立刻看到它在「正常 / 红绿色盲 / 蓝黄色盲 / 全色盲 /: Paste a palette to see how well its colours separate under 8 vision channels — normal, red-green, blue-yellow, achromatopsia and greyscale — with a ΔE matrix, flagged confusable pairs and one-click fix suggestions. All computed locally in the browser, no network requests.
map.模拟采用 Machado 等人（2009）的线性 RGB 变换矩阵，作用于线性光: The simulation uses the linear-RGB transformation matrices of Machado et al. (2009) in linear-light space, with colour weakness linearly interpolated between the identity and full matrix by severity; achromatopsia and greyscale are desaturated by Rec.709 relative luminance. Colour difference goes sRGB → CIE XYZ (D65) → CIE Lab, offering both CIE76 and CIE2000 metrics plus an OKLCH perceptual-distance overlay. Interpretation thresholds: ΔE<5 nearly indistinguishable (severe confusion), 5–10 hard to tell apart, 10–20 distinguishable, >20 clear. For chart palettes, any two colours should keep ΔE≥10 across all channels.
map.配色输入（每行一个 HEX，或用逗号 / 空格 / 顿号分隔，最多 14 色）: Palette input (one HEX per line, or separated by commas / spaces, up to 14 colours)
map.两两 ΔE 色差矩阵 · 混淆预警: Pairwise ΔE Colour-Difference Matrix · Confusion Warning
map.本工具是设计与自查辅助工具，所有模拟结果来自色彩科学模型的数学推算，: This tool is a design and self-check aid; all simulation results come from mathematical modelling of colour-science,
map.，也不能替代专业色觉检查（石原色盲检测图、Farnsworth D-15 排列测: , nor a replacement for professional colour-vision tests (Ishihara plates, Farnsworth D-15 arrangement test). Known limitations: severity uses linear interpolation and deviates from real spectral response; display gamut and brightness also affect perception; suggested fixes are heuristic starting points — verify against your actual use.
map.📚 深度解析：调色板色觉可辨识度检查器: 📚 Deep Dive: Palette Color Vision Accessibility Checker
map.，逐对检查在各类色觉缺陷下的可区分性并高亮风险对。: then check each pair's distinguishability under various colour-vision deficiencies and highlight risky pairs.
map.数据图表验收：核对分类色在色盲视角是否仍两两可分，避免图例误读。: Acceptance of data charts: verify categorical colours stay pairwise separable in colour-blind views to avoid legend misreading.
map.无障碍合规：为设计交付提供「色觉可辨识」复核依据，配合 WCAG 使用。: Accessibility compliance: provide a 'colour-vision distinguishable' review basis for design deliverables, used alongside WCAG.
map.对 5 色板逐对做 Machado 矩阵（按严重度）与去色变换，比较变换后感知距: Run Machado matrices (by severity) and desaturation on a 5-colour palette pairwise, comparing post-transform perceptual distance; red #E74C3C and green #27AE60 fall too close under some green deficiencies and get flagged yellow — suggest changing green to teal #16A085 to widen distinguishability.
map.检查器给出的是绝对结论吗？: Does the checker give an absolute conclusion?
map.不是。它给出的是按变换模型的近似可辨识度提示，用于复审与改进，真实可读性仍建议在: No. It gives an approximate distinguishability hint based on the transform model, for review and improvement; real readability should still be tested by colour-vision-deficient users on the target device.
map.全色盲下去色后仅剩明度差异，检查器会提示「仅靠明度区分」的风险，建议同步用形状/: After desaturation in achromatopsia only luminance remains; the checker flags the 'luminance-only distinction' risk and suggests also encoding with shape / texture / text.
map.严重度参数怎么选？: How to choose the severity parameter?
map.常用轻度到中度插值；若面向广泛人群，建议按中度（较严苛）评估，确保多数色觉缺陷用: Light-to-moderate interpolation is common; for broad audiences, evaluate at moderate (stricter) severity to ensure most colour-vision-deficient users can still distinguish.
map.生成在 8 种色觉类型下均可区分的安全配色，支持顺序/发散/定性模式、锁定色、明: Generate colour-safe palettes distinguishable under 8 vision types, with sequential/diverging/qualitative modes, colour locking, light-dark alternating strategy, 8-type
map.浏览器版 Farnsworth D-15 色相排列测试：15 个等亮度色帽拖拽排: Browser-based Farnsworth D-15 hue arrangement test: drag-sort 15 equal-luminance colour caps, output hue-trace chart,
map.对已有配色逐对做色觉缺陷变换，量化各类缺陷下的感知距离并标出可能混淆的组合。: Transform an existing palette pairwise through colour-vision deficiencies, quantify perceptual distance under each, and flag potentially confusing combinations.
